analysis: The code calls getValue on Map.Entry objects obtained from the entrySet of transferredNotes. The documentation of getValue states it may throw IllegalStateException if the entry has been removed from the backing map. In the loop, the map transferredNotes is not modified (only session.setNote is called on a different object). Therefore, the entries remain valid and the condition for IllegalStateException does not occur. Hence the exception is avoided.
remark: The triggering scenario for IllegalStateException is when the entry has been removed from the backing map. Since the map transferredNotes is not modified during the iteration, and no other code removes entries, the entries remain in the map. Therefore, this exception will not be thrown.
